title: Run Agent
subtitle: Launch a third-party agent via wrap (process HTTPS proxy + CA). Prefer copying the command into a terminal.
copyFirstHint: Browsers cannot start local terminal apps. Copy the command below; “Open in Terminal” is best-effort from the local Centag service (macOS uses a .command file).
presetsDesc: Select one to generate a wrap launch command.
customDesc: Enter an executable and args (whitespace-separated; no shell metacharacters).
terminalOpened: Tried to open a system terminal
terminalOpenFailed: Could not open a terminal automatically
terminalOpenFailedCopy: Could not open a terminal — use Copy and run it yourself
customRequired: Select a preset or enter a custom command first
loadFailed: Could not load presets (personal/minimal on this host, or loopback only)
desktopHint: For GUI apps (Claude Desktop, Trae, etc.), use System Proxy or Agent Setup instead of wrap run.
